source: ABB_0.81_RoboticSetting_CAADRIAmilling.gh, cluster 'Tooldata Definition' (the tool wired into its IK solver)
tcp_note: TCP is the cutter tip; its z points along the spindle axis. tool0 is the flange frame (z out of the flange), as ABB's tool0 and the URDF's tool0. On 2026-11-24 the tool was turned -120.3 deg about the flange's z and moved 7.7 mm, to put the TCP where the real robot's t_RRC_Act has it. Its x points back along the flange axis, as t_RRC_Act's does.
units: m (geometry and TCP); the source file is in mm
